CRWD.headline: DKS, OKTA, and CRWD: 3 Trending Stocks Making Big Moves
CRWD.description: DICK'S Sporting Goods (DKS), Okta (OKTA), and CrowdStrike (CRWD) have attracted investor attention following recent earnings releases. DKS disappointed with lowered guidance and weak Foot Locker performance, while OKTA and CRWD both delivered strong results with raised outlooks and positive EPS revisions.
